# Al Hadeeqa Contracting — Pergolas 2026

> Licensed Dubai construction contractor offering custom aluminium pergolas and outdoor structures since 2009. Three tiers from AED 15,000 to AED 90,000+. Dubai Municipality approvals included. ISO 9001:2015 / 14001:2015 / OHSAS 18001:2007 certified. 50+ in-house crew.

## Service
Custom aluminium pergola design, fabrication, and installation across Dubai, Abu Dhabi, and Sharjah. Built to UAE wind, sun, and humidity specification — not imported European catalogue systems. Includes Dubai Municipality drawing submission and approval.

## Tiers and Pricing
- Classic Shade — fixed aluminium pergola, from AED 15,000
- Louvered Shade — manually adjustable louvered roof, from AED 35,000
- Smart Shade — fully motorised with rain and wind sensors, app-controlled, from AED 90,000
- Aluminium Carports — single, double, multi-bay, from AED 18,000

## Add-on Services
- Exterior villa painting — 3-coat Jotun/Dulux systems, UV and salt resistant, from AED 18,000 for a 3-bedroom villa
- Bespoke outdoor scope — landscaping, paving, waterproofing, façade repair (quoted per project)

## Process
1. Free site visit and brief (Day 1)
2. 3D design and Dubai Municipality submission (Week 1)
3. In-house aluminium fabrication (Week 2–4)
4. Installation and handover with written warranty (2–4 days on site)

## Warranty
- Classic and Louvered Shade: 5-year structural warranty
- Smart Shade: up to 10-year frame warranty, 2-year motor and controls warranty

## Coverage
Dubai (primary), Abu Dhabi, Sharjah.
